slides.title: Real estate ke liye *3 automations* jo site visits badhate hain
slides.sub: Bina extra sales staff ke. Swipe →

slides.title: Problem: lead aayi, *call 2 din baad*
slides.sub: Tab tak buyer 4 aur builders se baat kar chuka hota hai.
slides.box: Property buyer ek saath kai projects compare karta hai. Jo pehle aur saaf jawab deta hai, visit wahi le jaata hai.

slides.title: 1. 5 second mein *WhatsApp reply*
slides.sub: Form bharte hi buyer ke paas:
slides.box:
Floor plan + price sheet 📎
Site visit ke 2 slot: "Sat 11 am ya Sun 4 pm?"

slides.title: 2. Sahi sales person ko *turant alert*
slides.sub: Lead kisi ke inbox mein pade-pade thandi na ho.
slides.box:
Area/budget ke hisaab se lead sahi bande ko.
15 min mein call nahi hua? Manager ko alert.

slides.title: 3. Visit ke baad *follow-up* apne aap
slides.sub: Zyaadatar deals pehli visit pe close nahi hote.
slides.box:
Din 1: thank you + location pin
Din 3: EMI calculator link
Din 7: offer / naya inventory update

slides.title: Bonus: *cost per site visit* naapo
slides.sub: Cost per lead dhokha de sakta hai.
slides.box: Visit ka data ad platform ko wapas bhejo. Phir ads "form bharne wale" nahi, "visit karne wale" log dhoondhte hain.

slides.title: Aapke projects mein *kahan leads chhoot* rahi hain?

caption:
